text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right before the race, Royce and Royce was quietly staring at a point in the sky, seemingly deep in concentration.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Rather than being nervous—
I suppose you could say I'm just organizing my tasks.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Positioning during the race, the timing of the spurt,
the face basking in the afterglow of victory, the cute way she wipes her sweat.
Everything shapes the story of 'The Strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, simulation complete.
Well then, shall we get going?
Time to show them the "strongest" Lois and Lois!
